title: Large Order Enumerative Geometry, Black Holes and Black Rings
summary: Exploiting newly available data on Gopakumar-Vafa invariants at high genus for one-parameter hypergeometric Calabi-Yau threefolds, we study numerically the growth of the 5D indices, stable pair (PT) invariants and rank one Donaldson-Thomas (DT) invariants at large charges. For the 5D index $Ω_{5D}(d,m)$, below a critical value of the angular momentum $m$, we find perfect agreement with the Bekenstein-Hawking-Wald entropy of rotating 5D BMPV black holes, including the subleading correction from four-derivative interactions.
